subject: english
question:
Select the incorrectly spelt word from the given sentence.

Her thought of him was vage, nebulous, and taking many forms.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"vage"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is "vague". "Vague" means not clearly expressed, known, described, or decided. (अस्पष्ट)

 
 
• **Example: **Her directions were so **vague** that we got lost.
 
 
 
• **"Vague" **is the correct spelling and refers to something that is not clearly expressed or defined. (अस्पष्ट)
 
 
• **Example: **His vague answers did not help us understand the situation.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Nebulous **(धुंधला): In the form of a cloud or haze; unclear, vague, or ill-defined.

 
 
• **Example:** His memories of childhood are nebulous at best.
 
 
 
• **Forms **(रूप): The visible shape or configuration of something.
 
 
• **Example: **The forms of the mountains were visible from a distance.
 
 
 
• **Thought** (विचार): An idea or opinion produced by thinking or occurring suddenly in the mind.
 
 
• **Example:** The thought of seeing her again made him happy.
